# dotplasma

> A small Go CLI for saving, comparing, importing, and cautiously restoring KDE Plasma desktop configuration as plain files.

Repository: https://github.com/A-Murchison/dot-plasma
Go module: github.com/A-Murchison/dot-plasma
Binary: dotplasma
Also known as: dot-plasma
License: MIT
Primary language: Go

## What this project is

`dotplasma` snapshots an allowlisted set of KDE Plasma configuration files from a user's home directory into a profile directory. The saved profile is made of normal files that can be reviewed, diffed, copied, backed up, or committed to Git by the user.

It is meant for KDE Plasma users who want safer desktop configuration backups, human-reviewable Plasma dotfiles, and cautious restore/migration workflows.

- KDE Plasma

- dot-plasma
- `konsave` alternative

## Main commands

- `dotplasma doctor`: validate the local environment and selected output directory.
- `dotplasma inspect-live`: show which known Plasma files exist on the current machine.
- `dotplasma save <profile>`: save live Plasma config into a named profile.
- `dotplasma diff [profile]`: compare a saved profile with the live desktop config.
- `dotplasma list`: list saved profiles.
- `dotplasma import <source-dir> <profile>`: import a profile without applying it.
- `dotplasma apply <profile>`: restore a profile, with `--dry-run` and mandatory pre-restore backups.

## Safety model

- No root required.
- No network access required.
- No automatic Git commits or remote sync.
- Only known allowlisted Plasma files are tracked.
- Writing commands support `--dry-run`.
- Restore backs up changed live files before writing.
- Plasma Shell reload is opt-in with `--reload plasmashell`.
